title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls — Protection Contract Pounds on the Refrigerant Allowance
content:
A Comfort Club member's refrigerant allowance on a completed Repair and Emergency Service Calls visit is raised when the home carries Harbison Protection Contracts. The records read are the customer's protection contracts in active status and the unit each covers, compared with the unit the call is about.

**Rule.** A call on a unit covered by an active Harbison protection contract adds 0.3 pound to the refrigerant allowance pounds. A call on a unit without one, at a home where another unit carries an active protection contract, adds 0.1 pound. Any other call adds nothing. The pounds so added count toward the refrigerant allowance pounds before the pounds covered are taken.

## Decision table

| The call's unit is covered by an active protection contract | Another unit at the home carries an active protection contract | Pounds added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | 0.3 pound |
| No | Yes | 0.1 pound |
| No | No | Nothing |

A contract in pending, expired, transferred or cancelled status is not an active protection contract.

## Example (hypothetical)

A home has an active protection contract on its air conditioner. A call on the furnace adds 0.1 pound, and a call on the air conditioner adds 0.3 pound.
